verdict.rationale: Filtering installs and scripts to a subset of workspace packages is a fair question for a package manager like npm, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions workspaces, workspace-filtered installs or scripts, or selecting packages affected by a change. The registry search filters (scope:, author:) are a different feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run installs and scripts filtered to a subset of workspace packages (including only those affected by a change)
